cards.name: CC Radial Fast Blur
cards.summary: Fast zoom-style radial blur that streaks the image outward from a centre point, like a crash zoom or light rays bursting from the middle.
use_for: zoom-blur transition between two clips (keyframe Amount up then cut)
impact punch-in on a reel hook or headline reveal
trailer title slam with streaking glow
dreamy flashback burst from a face or object
avoid: Amount above ~70 for more than a few frames turns the frame to mush
Brightest/Darkest zoom modes clip faces into blown or crushed streaks on press footage

params.name: Center
params.does: point the streaks radiate from (comp pixels)

params.name: Amount
params.does: length of the radial streaks (0-100)

params.name: Zoom
params.does: blend mode of the streaks: 1 Standard, 2 Brightest (light-ray glow), 3 Darkest

cards.scripting: Center is a 2D point in comp pixels. Zoom is a 1-based popup; labels Standard|Brightest|Darkest read from the installed plug-in (RadialFastBlur.aex). Harvested default Amount is 50, so applying it with no props already blurs heavily. Premiere 2026 has no static radial/zoom blur filter: for a crash-zoom feel use Premiere's 'Grow' or 'Shrink' (scale animation with built-in Motion Blur) or Transform scale keyframes with shutter angle.

verified.note: Strong zoom blur streaks radiate outward from the frame centre, faces and stripes smeared toward the edges like a crash zoom.

cards.name: CC Vector Blur
cards.summary: Smears pixels along the brightness contours of the layer (or of a chosen vector-map layer), giving a flowing, painterly or liquid streak look rather than a uniform blur.
use_for: painterly or liquid transition into a flashback / archival section
abstract textured background plate for explainer titles
dream or memory sequence stylisation in documentaries
organic smear driven by a Fractal Noise map for trailer texture
avoid: faces turn into smudged wax at high Amount, avoid on talking heads
negative or large Amount values on fine text make it unreadable

params.name: Type
params.does: how the vector field is read: 1 Natural, 2 Constant Length, 3 Perpendicular, 4 Direction Center, 5 Direction Fading

params.name: Amount
params.does: smear length in pixels; sign flips the direction

params.name: Angle Offset
params.does: rotates the smear direction (degrees)

params.name: Ridge Smoothness
params.does: smooths sharp ridges in the vector field

params.name: Vector Map
params.does: layer whose values define the flow (none = the layer itself)

params.name: Property
params.does: which channel of the vector map drives the field: 1 Red, 2 Green, 3 Blue, 4 Alpha, 5 Luminance, 6 Lightness, 7 Hue, 8 Saturation

params.name: Map Softness
params.does: pre-blurs the vector map so the flow is smoother

cards.scripting: Vector Map is a layer reference and cannot be set from a spec; with it unset the effect uses the layer's own content. Type and Property are 1-based popups; both label lists were read from the installed plug-in (CycoreFXHD/VectorBlur.aex), so they are exact. Harvested default Amount is 0 (no-op): always set Amount. Premiere has no CC effects and no vector/flow blur.

verified.note: Pixels smear along the image's own contours into a liquid, painterly look with bright halo outlines tracing the figures, stripes and foreground blocks.

cards.name: Camera Lens Blur
cards.summary: Realistic optical defocus that imitates a real lens, with shaped bokeh (iris blades) and blooming highlights; optionally driven by a depth/blur-map layer.
use_for: rack-focus reveal: blur the plate then pull focus to the subject
defocused background behind lower thirds, quotes or title cards
cinematic trailer bokeh with blooming city lights
fake shallow depth of field with a gradient or depth map as Blur Map
avoid: very heavy at large Blur Radius on 1080p+ comps; preview at lower res
uniform blur with no Blur Map looks like a smeared photo, not depth of field
high Gain blows faces and flags into white blobs

params.name: Blur Radius
params.does: strength of the defocus in pixels

params.name: Shape
params.does: iris blade count / bokeh shape: 1 Triangle ... 8 Decagon (default 4 Hexagon)

params.name: Roundness
params.does: rounds the iris shape towards a circle

params.name: Layer
params.does: Blur Map layer (depth/gradient) that controls where it blurs (layer reference, not settable from a spec)
params.typical: a Gradient Ramp or depth pass layer

params.name: Channel
params.does: which channel of the Blur Map is read: 1 Luminance, 2 Red, 3 Green, 4 Blue, 5 Alpha

params.name: Blur Focal Distance
params.does: map value (raw 0-1) that stays in focus

params.name: Gain
params.does: brightens highlights into bokeh balls

params.name: Threshold
params.does: brightness (raw 0-1) above which highlights bloom

params.name: Saturation
params.does: keeps colour in the boosted highlights

cards.scripting: The Blur Map 'Layer' is a layer reference (0 = none) and cannot be set from a spec; without it the blur is uniform. Threshold and Blur Focal Distance are raw 0-1 values (the UI shows 0-255). Shape, Channel and Placement are 1-based popups; all three label lists were read from the installed plug-in (ShapeBlur.aex). Invert Blur Map, Edge Behavior (Repeat Edge Pixels) and Use Linear Working Space are 0/1 checkboxes. Premiere 2026 equivalent is the new 'Bokeh Blur' (Aperture Edges/Roundness, Gain; different props); for tilt-shift / selective focus in Premiere use 'Focus Blur'.

verified.note: Whole frame is evenly defocused like an out-of-focus lens; this plate has few point highlights so bokeh shapes are not distinct.

cards.name: Camera-Shake Deblur
cards.summary: Repairs motion blur caused by handheld camera shake by rebuilding blurred frames from sharper neighbouring frames; it does nothing visible on steady or still footage.
use_for: rescue shaky handheld rally / ground-report footage after Warp Stabilizer
clean up phone-shot news clips with shake blur
sharpen smeared frames in archival handheld material before a freeze-frame
avoid: no effect on tripod or still footage, so a demo frame may look unchanged
cannot fix out-of-focus or subject-motion blur, only shake blur
high Strength on fast pans produces ghosting / doubled edges

params.name: Blur Duration
params.does: popup: window of neighbouring frames searched for sharp detail, 1 = 5 Frames, 2 = 7 Frames, 3 = 9 Frames
params.typical: 1 (5 Frames); 2-3 when the shake blur lasts over several frames

params.name: Deblur Method
params.does: popup: 1 Standard, 2 High Quality (slower)
params.typical: 1 for previews, 2 for the final render

params.name: Strength
params.does: how strongly blurred frames are replaced (0-200)

params.name: Shake Sensitivity
params.does: how much shake counts as blur to fix (0-100)

cards.scripting: Analyses neighbouring frames, so it needs real video (not a still) with handheld shake; on steady footage the result looks the same as the source even at max settings (measured on the locked-off test_a.mp4 at Strength 200 / Shake Sensitivity 100: only faint block-shaped patch swaps from neighbouring frames, mean 4/255, and a slightly softer frame, no visible deblur), so a render test on a tripod shot proves nothing. Popup labels were read from the installed plug-in (Deblur.aex), whose own description says to apply it after stabilizing: put it below Warp Stabilizer in the stack. Premiere has no deblur effect. Exact semantics of Strength / Shake Sensitivity are inferred, not documented. Measured on a synthetic handheld plate (random per-frame shake, directional blur on about a third of the frames; live wave 3) at the demo's maximum settings: block-shaped patches from sharp neighbours replace parts of the blurred frames, raising their sharpness about 4 % (4.47 -> 4.64; sharp frames about 9.5), so most of the blur stays.

verified.note: On a blurred frame of the shaky plate some patches (grid lines in the left bars) come back sharp, but most of the frame stays smeared (sharpness +4 % at Strength 200 / Shake Sensitivity 100, the maximum): the effect acts, too faintly to judge; the synthetic blur direction need not match the shake the plug-in estimates.

previous.why: the test footage has nothing for it to act on (see note), so the render could not show it doing its job
judged on the live wave 3 re-render on the second (synthetic) footage set, which has what the card acts on
previous.note: No visible deblur: 006.png looks the same as the untouched render (no-op frames such as 051/133/262, all source frame 43 of test_a.mp4). It is not pixel-identical (mean diff 4.3/255, max 68, block-shaped patch swaps, Laplacian sharpness 65 vs 70, i.e. slightly softer), but nothing a viewer would read as the effect. Cause: test_a.mp4 (and test_b.mp4) is a locked-off tripod clip with zero global frame-to-frame shift, only flash-lit exposure jumps, so there is no shake blur to repair. Demo settings are in range (Strength 200 of 0-200, Shake Sensitivity 100 of 0-100) and already maxed; no setting can show it on this source. Status needs_input: it needs a handheld clip with shake blur as the demo source.
previous.second_opinion: corrected: verdict and needs_input status stand, but the note's facts were wrong: the demo source is a locked-off video clip, not a still plate, and 006.png is not pixel-identical to the untouched render (mean 4.3/255 block-pattern patch swaps, slightly softer, no visible deblur); also tightened the scripting claim to match the measurement.

cards.name: Channel Blur
cards.summary: Blurs the red, green, blue and alpha channels separately, so colours bleed and fringe at different amounts; also softens a layer's alpha edge.
use_for: dreamy colour-bleed look for flashbacks or nostalgia beats
soft RGB fringe for glitch / tech explainer titles
feather a cut-out or text alpha edge with Alpha Blurriness
retro VHS-ish colour smear on archival clips
avoid: large red blur on skin makes faces look bleeding or sunburnt
too subtle to read on small phone screens below ~5 px

params.name: Red Blurriness
params.does: blur of the red channel in pixels

params.name: Green Blurriness
params.does: blur of the green channel in pixels

params.name: Blue Blurriness
params.does: blur of the blue channel in pixels

params.name: Alpha Blurriness
params.does: softens the alpha edge (cut-outs, text)

params.name: Edge Behavior
params.does: 1 = repeat edge pixels so frame edges do not go dark

params.name: Blur Dimensions
params.does: 1 Horizontal and Vertical, 2 Horizontal, 3 Vertical

cards.scripting: All blurriness values are raw pixels. Edge Behavior is a 0/1 checkbox (Repeat Edge Pixels); Blur Dimensions is a 1-based popup. Premiere 2026 has no Channel Blur; the closest look there is 'RGB Split' (offsets channels instead of blurring them).

verified.note: Red channel bleeds far beyond edges with cyan/green fringes on faces, stripes and the tops of the foreground blocks, a clear colour-bleed look.

cards.name: Compound Blur
cards.summary: Blurs the layer by varying amounts according to the brightness of a control (blur) layer: white areas of the map get the Maximum Blur, black areas stay sharp.
use_for: tilt-shift / miniature look with a gradient as the blur layer
selective focus: keep a speaker sharp while the crowd blurs
blur transition driven by an animated wipe or noise layer
fake depth of field for still photos in documentaries
avoid: using the footage itself as the blur layer gives uneven, random-looking blur
large Maximum Blur on a noisy map creates blotchy edges
frame borders darken (no repeat-edge option); scale the layer up slightly or crop when used full-frame

params.name: Blur Layer
params.does: layer whose luminance controls blur amount (white = most blur)
params.typical: a Gradient Ramp or Fractal Noise precomp

params.name: Maximum Blur
params.does: blur in pixels where the map is white

params.name: If Layer Sizes Differ
params.does: 1 = stretch the map to fit the layer

params.name: Invert Blur
params.does: 1 = black areas blur, white stay sharp

cards.scripting: Blur Layer is a layer reference (index, default 1) and cannot be set from a spec; in a one-layer comp it points to the layer itself, so the image's own brightness drives the blur (bright areas blur). For controlled results a script must add the map layer and point Blur Layer at it via ExtendScript. The map uses the map layer's source (effects/masks on it are ignored), so precompose a generated map first. 'If Layer Sizes Differ' is a checkbox labelled Stretch Map to Fit. Premiere 2026's 'Compound Blur' is a different (new, Impact-based) effect with the same idea but other props (Blur Layer as a track, Blur Amount 0-100, Depth, Feather, Gain); do not reuse these prop names there.

verified.note: Bright background and faces are heavily blurred while the darkest clothing areas keep more detail, and the frame border darkens.

cards.name: Directional Blur
cards.summary: Blurs along a single angle, creating motion streaks as if the camera or subject moved quickly in that direction.
use_for: whip-pan transition between news clips (keyframe Blur Length up and down)
speed streaks on a sliding headline or name strap as it enters
kinetic text slams in reel hooks
fake motion on a still photo push
avoid: Blur Length high for long holds makes footage unreadable
angle that does not match the actual move looks fake

params.name: Direction
params.does: blur angle in degrees; 0 = vertical streaks, 90 = horizontal streaks
params.typical: 90 for horizontal whip pans, 0 for vertical

params.name: Blur Length
params.does: streak length in pixels

cards.scripting: Direction is an angle in degrees (raw value, no min/max). Match name is 'ADBE Motion Blur' even though the display name is Directional Blur. Harvested defaults are Direction 90 and Blur Length 10, so applying it bare already gives a slight horizontal blur. Use Motion Tile with mirror edges before it in a transition so edges do not show transparency. In Premiere 2026 the identical engine (same match, same props) is 'Directional Blur (Legacy)'; Premiere's new 'Directional Blur' is a different Impact-based effect (Angle, Amount 0-100, Chromatic Aberration).

verified.note: Horizontal motion streaks smear vertical edges sideways (thin poles, figures) while horizontal stripes stay readable.

cards.name: Fast Box Blur
cards.summary: Fast general-purpose blur; with 1 iteration it gives a boxy, square-ish blur, with 3 or more it approaches a smooth Gaussian blur.
use_for: blurred background fill behind 16:9 footage in a 9:16 reel
soften a plate behind text cards and quotes
quick blur-in / blur-out transition
frosted glass panel behind lower thirds (with a mask)
avoid: Iterations 1 shows square artefacts on highlights
without Repeat Edge Pixels the frame edges go dark / transparent

params.name: Blur Radius
params.does: blur size in pixels

params.name: Iterations
params.does: number of passes; more = smoother Gaussian-like blur

params.name: Blur Dimensions
params.does: 1 Horizontal and Vertical, 2 Horizontal, 3 Vertical

params.name: Repeat Edge Pixels
params.does: 1 = keep frame edges solid

cards.scripting: Blur Dimensions is a 1-based popup; Repeat Edge Pixels is a 0/1 checkbox. Radius is in raw pixels; harvested default is 0, so always set Blur Radius. It replaced the old Fast Blur (now 'Fast Blur (Legacy)', ADBE Fast Blur, in AE's Obsolete category). Premiere 2026 has no box blur; its 'Fast Blur' is that legacy engine (Blurriness, Blur Dimensions, Repeat Edge Pixels) and is the closest match.

verified.note: Whole frame is smoothly and heavily blurred with solid edges, as a background-fill blur.

cards.name: Gaussian Blur
cards.summary: Smooth, even, high-quality blur of the whole layer; the standard blur for softening, background fills and blur transitions.
use_for: blurred 9:16 background fill behind a 16:9 clip in reels
soften a plate behind headlines, quote cards and lower thirds
blur-to-sharp reveal at the start of a story
obscure faces / number plates together with a mask
avoid: without Repeat Edge Pixels the frame edges fade to transparent / black
uniform blur reads as 'blurry footage', not lens defocus; use Camera Lens Blur for cinematic depth

params.name: Blurriness
params.does: blur amount in pixels

params.name: Blur Dimensions
params.does: 1 Horizontal and Vertical, 2 Horizontal, 3 Vertical

params.name: Repeat Edge Pixels
params.does: 1 = keep frame edges solid

cards.scripting: Use match 'ADBE Gaussian Blur 2' (the current GPU version), not 'ADBE Gaussian Blur' (AE's obsolete 'Gaussian Blur (Legacy)'). Harvested default Blurriness is 25, so applying it with no props already blurs; set Blurriness 0 explicitly if you only want to keyframe later. Naming trap in Premiere 2026: the same engine (AE.ADBE Gaussian Blur 2, same props) is listed there as 'Gaussian Blur (Legacy)', while Premiere's new 'Gaussian Blur' is a different Impact-based effect (Amount 0-100, Thickness, Chromatic Aberration).

verified.note: Whole frame is evenly softened with a smooth blur and solid frame edges.

cards.name: Radial Blur
cards.summary: Blurs around a centre point either in circles (Spin) or outward (Zoom), giving a rotating or crash-zoom motion feel.
use_for: zoom-blur transition into the next clip in reels and trailers
spin-blur transition for energetic explainer segments
impact punch on a breaking-news title reveal
dizzy / disoriented POV moment in documentary recreations
avoid: high Amount with Antialiasing Low shows banding
slow to render at high Amount on 1080p+ (preview at lower res)

params.name: Amount
params.does: strength (Spin: degrees of rotation blur; Zoom: streak length)

params.name: Center
params.does: centre of the spin/zoom in comp pixels

params.name: Type
params.does: 1 Spin, 2 Zoom

params.name: Antialiasing (Best Quality)
params.does: quality at Best render: 1 Low, 2 High

params.name: Random Seed
params.does: varies the sampling noise pattern

cards.scripting: Type and Antialiasing are 1-based popups; labels Spin|Zoom and Low|High read from the installed plug-in (Radial_Blur.aex). Center is a 2D point in comp pixels. Slow at high Amount; CC Radial Fast Blur is the quick zoom-only alternative. Premiere 2026 has no static radial blur filter: use its 'Spin' (rotation with Motion Blur) or 'Grow' / 'Shrink' (scale with Motion Blur) Impact effects, or Transform scale/rotation keyframes with shutter angle.

verified.note: Zoom-type radial streaks burst outward from the frame centre, centre fairly readable and edges strongly streaked.

cards.name: Sharpen
cards.summary: Increases contrast at edges so the image looks crisper; simple one-slider sharpening.
use_for: crisp up soft upscaled or web-sourced press footage
restore detail after scaling a still photo for a Ken Burns move
add bite to AI-generated shots in reels
light final polish (10-20) on soft talking-head footage
avoid: above ~40 it creates white halos and amplifies compression blocks and noise
sharpening faces exaggerates skin texture and pores

params.name: Sharpen Amount
params.does: edge contrast boost (only property)

cards.scripting: Single raw value; harvested default is 0 (no-op), so always set Sharpen Amount. The demo value 100 is deliberately strong so the render test shows it; use 10-30 in real edits. Place after scaling/transform effects and before grain/noise so the grain is not sharpened. Unsharp Mask gives finer control (radius, threshold). Premiere's 'Sharpen' is the same engine (AE.ADBE Sharpen, same prop name).

verified.note: Edges are visibly crisper with bright halos around faces and amplified compression blocks, as the card warns at high amounts.

cards.name: Smart Blur
cards.summary: Blurs flat areas while keeping strong edges sharp, smoothing skin and noise into a soft, painted look; Edge Only mode outputs just the edges as lines.
use_for: quick skin / noise smoothing on low-quality interview or phone footage
posterised cartoon look for satire segments (with Posterize)
line-art sketch look via Edge Only mode for explainer flashbacks
clean a noisy still before animating it
avoid: high Radius + Threshold makes faces look waxy / plastic
slow on 4K; Edge Only output is mostly black and needs blending

params.name: Radius
params.does: size of the blur in flat areas

params.name: Threshold
params.does: how strong an edge must be to stay sharp

params.name: Mode
params.does: 1 Normal, 2 Edge Only (white lines on black), 3 Overlay Edge (white edges over image)

cards.scripting: Mode is a 1-based popup; labels Normal|Edge Only|Overlay Edge read from the installed plug-in (SmartBlur.aex). Radius and Threshold minimum is 0.1 (0 is out of range). For a sketch look use Mode 2 then Invert, or Mode 3 for edges over the image. For natural skin / noise smoothing AE's Bilateral Blur (ADBE Bilateral) usually looks less plastic. Premiere has no Smart Blur.

verified.note: Skin and flat areas are smoothed while strong edges (stripes, dark clothing outlines) stay fairly crisp, a soft edge-preserving blur.
